description: This PHP source file defines the IamClient class for interacting with AWS IAM services. It includes method annotations for various IAM operations, indicating a client wrapper around the AWS SDK.

classes.name: IamClient
classes.description: A client class for the AWS IAM service, extending AwsClient and providing methods to interact with IAM.

methods.name: addClientIDToOpenIDConnectProvider
methods.description: Adds a client ID to an OpenID Connect provider.

methods.name: addRoleToInstanceProfile
methods.description: Adds a role to an instance profile.

methods.name: addUserToGroup
methods.description: Adds a user to an IAM group.

methods.name: attachGroupPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a policy to a group.

methods.name: attachRolePolicy
methods.description: Attaches a policy to a role.

methods.name: createAccessKey
methods.description: Creates a new access key for a user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified IAM user.
